items.title: BIO 2026: NVIDIA announces the BioNeMo toolkit for AI agents
items.summary: The suite of tools is designed to allow AI to carry out R&D work more quickly, reliably, and in a continuous innovation loop.

items.title: From collection to confidence: why clinical trial data reliability starts early
items.summary: Reliable clinical trial data starts in Phase 1. Learn how early quality signals protect safety and guide confident sponsor decisions.

items.title: BIO 2026: Cell and gene therapy firms outline their use of AI in manufacturing
items.summary: From data lakes to streamlined production, Kriya, Opus, and Epicrispr discuss how technology is improving their operations.

items.title: FDA changes rare disease tune again as it clears path for Regenxbio’s gene therapy
items.summary: With a regulatory route now in place, Regenxbio expects to meet with the FDA again in July, with a BLA resubmission to follow in Q3 2026.

items.title: Genprex’s Reqorsa combo secures Canadian patent for lung cancer
items.summary: Genprex has received a Notice of Allowance from the CIPO for a patent related to the use of its Reqorsa gene therapy in combination with either PD-1 or PD-L1 antibodies to treat NSCLC and SCLC.
